items.title: Block stock jumps as Jack Dorsey's AI bet shows signs of paying off
items.summary: Eight months after Jack Dorsey made one of corporate America's boldest bets on shrinking its workforce to prepare for the age of artificial intelligence, investors are finding more reasons to buy into the Silicon Valley billionaire's pivot.

items.title: Block Soars 14% on Raised 2026 Outlook, Says AI Shift Has “Meaningfully Crossed the Chasm”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBlock shares jumped 14% on a strong third quarter and higher 2026 guidance. Its first 2027 outlook calls for at least 15% gross profit growth and a 32% adjusted operating margin.

items.title: Democrats take Congress after crypto’s election spending fails
items.summary: Democrats are projected to take both chambers of Congress, shifting control of crypto legislation despite the industry spending tens of millions to back Republicans. Sherrod Brown won his Ohio seat back after crypto PACs poured $63 million into defeating him, and Elizabeth Warren is now likely to chair the Senate Banking Committee. CoinDesk’s Jennifer Sanasie hosts “CoinDesk Daily.”

items.title: Block Shares Jump More Than 6% as Cash App Growth Drives Q3 Earnings Beat and Higher 2026 Guidance
items.summary: Block Inc. (NYSE:XYZ) shares climbed more than 6% in premarket trading on Wednesday after the financial technology company reported stronger-than-expected third-quarter 2026 earnings and revenue, supported by continued growth across its Cash App and Square businesses.
